raw.query: WITH cells AS (SELECT variate, resolution, model, MIN(wape) AS mw FROM provenance.forecast_metrics WHERE candidate='point' AND h=-1 GROUP BY variate, resolution, model), agg AS (SELECT variate, resolution, MIN(CASE WHEN model IN ('chronos','timesfm','toto') THEN mw END) AS fm_min, MIN(CASE WHEN model NOT IN ('chronos','timesfm','toto') THEN mw END) AS base_min FROM cells GROUP BY variate, resolution) SELECT variate, resolution, fm_min, base_min, CASE WHEN fm_min < base_min THEN 'WIN' ELSE 'LOSE' END AS verdict FROM agg ORDER BY variate, resolution
raw.observed: Foundation-model best WAPE < classical-baseline best WAPE in 20/20 cells (4 variates x 5 resolutions); tightest margin images@1min: chronos 0.5292 < ewma 0.5416
raw.claimed: the foundation models beat every baseline in all twenty cells, zero-shot, with no per-series tuning
raw.evidence: Across point-forecast (h=-1) WAPE, the minimum foundation-model WAPE is below the minimum baseline WAPE in every one of the 20 (signal,resolution) cells.
